change: Changed loop condition from `i <= items.length` to `i < items.length` to prevent out-of-bounds access.
Changed return value from `subtotal * discount` to `subtotal * (1 - discount)` so the discount is subtracted, not applied as a multiplier.
Added an early-return guard `if (items.length === 0) return 0;` before the divide to prevent NaN.
Replaced `items.sort(...)` with `[...items].sort(...)` so the original array is not mutated.
Replaced `'$' + amount` with `'$' + amount.toFixed(2)` to produce a properly formatted currency string.
